unknown_dialect_diagnostic.hint: Lower '{operation}' to a dialect allowed by the selected Track.

unknown_type_diagnostic.hint: Replace '{object}' with a type allowed by the selected Track.

unknown_attribute_diagnostic.hint: Replace or remove '{object}' using attributes allowed by the selected Track.

resource_limit_diagnostic.message: AnchorIR structural resource limit exceeded at '{object}'
resource_limit_diagnostic.hint: Reduce AnchorIR operation nesting, operation count, or nested object structure before validation.

parse_failure_diagnostic.message: Failed to parse the MLIR module
parse_failure_diagnostic.hint: Fix the MLIR syntax and ensure the input contains one builtin.module.

verify_failure_diagnostic.hint: Fix the reported MLIR or Dialect invariant before AnchorIR validation.

forbidden_dialect_diagnostic.message: Forbidden dialect '{dialect}' is not permitted in Linalg Track
forbidden_dialect_diagnostic.hint: Fully lower '{operation}' to the Linalg Track before the AnchorIR boundary.

forbidden_type_diagnostic.message: Forbidden type dialect '{dialect}' in '{object}' is not permitted in Linalg Track
forbidden_type_diagnostic.hint: Fully lower or replace '{object}' before the Linalg AnchorIR boundary.

forbidden_attribute_diagnostic.message: Forbidden attribute dialect '{dialect}' in '{object}' is not permitted in Linalg Track
forbidden_attribute_diagnostic.hint: Remove or replace '{object}' before the Linalg AnchorIR boundary.

linalg.no_unrealized_conversion_cast.hint: Complete the Triton/GPU-to-Linalg conversion before the AnchorIR boundary.

linalg.ranked_shaped_values.message: Linalg operation '{operation}' requires ranked shaped value '{object}'
linalg.ranked_shaped_values.hint: Materialize a ranked tensor or memref shape before this Linalg operation.

linalg.generic_region_contract.message: linalg.generic '{operation}' has an incomplete region/yield contract
linalg.generic_region_contract.hint: Provide one region block, matching input/init block arguments, and one linalg.yield value for every destination-style init/output.

forbidden_dialect_diagnostic.message: Forbidden dialect '{dialect}' is not permitted in TritonGPU Track
forbidden_dialect_diagnostic.hint: Remove or lower '{operation}' before the TritonGPU AnchorIR boundary.

forbidden_type_diagnostic.message: Forbidden type dialect '{dialect}' in '{object}' is not permitted in TritonGPU Track
forbidden_type_diagnostic.hint: Remove or replace '{object}' before the TritonGPU AnchorIR boundary.

forbidden_attribute_diagnostic.message: Forbidden attribute dialect '{dialect}' in '{object}' is not permitted in TritonGPU Track
forbidden_attribute_diagnostic.hint: Remove or replace '{object}' before the TritonGPU AnchorIR boundary.

gpu.tensor_encoding.message: TritonGPU shaped object '{object}' used by '{operation}' has no Track-compatible encoding
gpu.tensor_encoding.hint: Attach a dialect encoding to the tensor or memdesc before the AnchorIR boundary; builtin attributes are not GPU layouts.

gpu.module_configuration.message: TritonGPU module configuration is missing or invalid at '{object}'
gpu.module_configuration.hint: Set positive int32-range triton_gpu.num-warps, triton_gpu.threads-per-warp, and triton_gpu.num-ctas values, and make Distributed Encoding warp/thread/CTA products, including wrapped parent layouts, match them.

gpu.encoding_rank.message: TritonGPU encoding rank does not match shaped object '{object}'
gpu.encoding_rank.hint: Match encoding vectors to the tensor rank or ordinary memdesc rank; a staged Shared memdesc may have one leading positive numStages dimension beyond the Shared layout rank, and every Slice dim must be inside its parent rank.

gpu.encoding_components.message: TritonGPU encoding '{object}' has unsafe or unsupported layout components
gpu.encoding_components.hint: Use a supported tensor element count, positive MemDesc shapes and topology fields, power-of-two Blocked/CTA components where required, a valid CTA split/order, compatible tensor/layout kinds, and an MMA version, rank, warp layout, and instruction shape supported by the pinned backend.

gpu.shaped_element_type.message: TritonGPU shaped object '{object}' has an unsupported element type
gpu.shaped_element_type.hint: Use Triton-supported integer or floating-point elements; ranked tensors may also contain !tt.ptr elements, but memdesc elements may not.

gpu.operation_contract.message: Triton operation '{operation}' has an unsafe or incomplete semantic contract
gpu.operation_contract.hint: Satisfy the operation-specific axis, rank, shape and operand/result cardinality rules; use valid block-pointer metadata, permutation, offsets, boundary dimensions and padding; keep count attributes nonnegative; and provide a registered layout interface when encoding inference is required.

gpu.dot_encoding_contract.message: tt.dot '{operation}' has an incomplete operand/result shape or encoding contract
gpu.dot_encoding_contract.hint: Use layouts accepted by Triton's Dot interface and make A[M,K] * B[K,N], accumulator and result shapes compatible.
